formula: consecutive count of days where volume > 1.5 * SMA(volume,20)
code:
def factor_volume_streak_persistent(df):
    """Consecutive days of elevated volume – persistent institutional activity."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    volume_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_cond = df_copy["volume"] > 1.5 * volume_ma
    group = (vol_cond != vol_cond.shift(1)).cumsum()
    streak = vol_cond.groupby(group).cumcount() + 1
    factor = streak * vol_cond
    df_copy["factor_volume_streak_persistent"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_streak_persistent"]
description: Measures the persistence of abnormal volume. A prolonged streak of high-volume days signals strong and sustained institutional interest or a liquidity event, which can precede significant price movement. The streak length captures temporal clustering of volume spikes.
